title: Item:Tome of Fate
wikitext:
{{TomeTOC}}
__NOTOC__[[File:Tome of Fate +1.png |thumb|right|420px|Tome of Fate +1]]
''This thick book enhances your connection to your epic destinies. Entwined with the word is a powerful magical effect that grants one bonus fate point to your character.''

Tomes of Fate grant +1 to +3 [[Fate Point]]s.
* All tomes are Minimum Level: 20
* All tomes are {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}.
* Tome provided a [[Inherent bonus]] type and do not stack with other [[inherent bonus]] types.
* Bonuses from tomes persist through [[Reincarnation]].
* Unwanted tomes have no available trade-in option.

Acquired by:
* Purchase from the [[DDO Store]]
* [[Daily Dice|Gold Daily Dice]]
* Extremely rare chest loot

== Special feats ==

How to locate Destiny and Fate points acquired and from which tomes:
* You can check  your [[Character Sheet]] → Feats Tab → Special Feats to see the  [[Inherent bonus|Inherent Fate Points]] you have from Tomes of Fate.{{Image popup|[[File:Special Feats Inherent Fate Point.png|thumb|right|You can check your consumed Tome of Fate on your character sheet under special feats. Hover over Inherent Fate Point to see how many additional points do you have.''(mouse-hover for pop-up)'']]|Special Feats Inherent Fate Point.png|width=600}}
* You can check your [[Epic Destinies]] tree UI → Mouse-over "Destiny Points Spent" → a pop with a complete break down will appear, look for "From Fate Tomes".{{Image popup|[[File:Destiny Points Spent breakdown.png|thumb|right|Complete break down of Destiny and Fate points.''(mouse-hover for pop-up)'']]|Destiny Points Spent breakdown.png|width=600}}

== History ==
Prior to [[Update 51]] the Tome of Fate allowed you to unlock or upgrade Twist of Fate slots sooner than you would otherwise be able to.
